paper.title: Paper remaining
paper.daysUnknown: Not enough usage data to forecast

errors.not_found: This unit is not assigned to you.

roll.title: Change the paper roll

prepare.title: At the unit
prepare.body: Work calmly and respectfully; the site may be busy. Tick each step when done.
prepare.doorHint: Use the service key. The unit pauses printing while the cover is open.
prepare.remove: Remove the old roll and core
prepare.removeHint: Take the empty core and any loose paper with you.
prepare.load: Load the new roll, print side out
prepare.loadHint: Thermal side faces the print head; pull a few centimetres through the paper path.
prepare.cover: Close the printer cover and the service door
prepare.coverHint: Wait until the cover sensor reads “Closed”.

roll.photoLater: Attaching a photo of the installed roll is planned and not available yet.

specs.title: New roll specification
specs.body: Used to estimate remaining paper. Defaults match the standard 58 mm roll.
specs.invalid: Please check the values: the core must be smaller than the outer diameter.

confirm.title: Confirm the change
confirm.body: This closes the current roll, starts tracking the new one, clears paper alerts and resolves an open paper-change ticket.

success.title: Roll change recorded
success.body: Paper tracking restarted. A test print is recommended to verify printing, cutting and the chute sensor.

errors.not_found: This unit is not assigned to you.

tickets.title: Incidents & tickets
tickets.subtitle: Report incidents and keep a service history for your sites. Never write kvittel content or names here.
tickets.open: {count, plural, =0 {No open tickets} one {# open ticket} other {# open tickets}}
tickets.noneOpenBody: No open incidents at your sites.
